The '''Etheric Sea''' is a planet-wide phenomena born from an anomalous [[The Lament|Lament]] event. It now blankets [[Solaris-3|Solaris's]] sky, cutting the planet off from the rest of the universe and bringing all space exploration to a complete standstill as countless spacecraft were lost with space exploration programs abandoned since many satellites, probes, space stations and the like fell from their position and becoming debris upon landing back onto the planet. Research suggests it is composed of extremely high-density [[Remnant]] Energy. The envelopment of Solaris did not occur all at once, and was slow enough to allow the [[Court of Savantae]] to launch the [[SkyArk Space Station]] as part of the Etheric Sea Initiative to study the Sea in the early stages of the Post-Lament Anthropocene.

It is highly dangerous to be caught wherever the Etheric Sea converges, as it forms new [[Tacet Field|Tacet Fields]] and disrupts the functions of Terminals. The Remnant Energy makes it a magnet for [[Tacet Discord|Tacet Discords]]. Condensed droplets of Remnant Energy may fall from the Etheric Sea, a phenomenon known as [[Retroact Rain]], and this can be enhanced by the power of a [[Threnodian]].

Another property known to the Etheric Sea is defined as '''Etheric Sea Droplets'''. The droplets exhibit unique quantum properties. Used as a medium, they could help whoever harnesses them into potentially reaching places beyond Solaris-3, such as space, by utilizing them as a gateway. The [[SkyArk Space Station]] uses Etheric Sea as its core. Though when some dispersed, some space station sectors became unstable. The Mass Relay Device’s energy core onboard however can restore the Theric Sea Droplets disrupted by Voidmatter to a stable state, clearing obstacles that block one's path.

The [[Black Shores]] utilize Anchors to observe the Etheric Sea, eliminating the need for building a Nexus Tower in their headquarters.

According to the student Chevi in [[Lahai-Roi]], the Etheric Sea causes a refraction that warps everything in the sky. This causes celestial bodies like the moon to appear differently across the various regions such as [[Jinzhou]], the Black Shores, and [[Septimont]], making it difficult to tell if [[The Moon]] and potentially anything else above is even real due to how strange everything appears when looking.

[[Rover]] may have entered Solaris via the Sea, and the [[Schwarzloch|Grand Architect]], under the guise of a researcher named Weiying, funded the Etheric Sea Initiative after it stalled. Their interest is suspected to be in utilising the Sea, at least in the early stages, to reach somewhere beyond.

==Trivia==
*[[wp:Aether (classical element)|Aether]], also written ether, was the element in medieval science which filled the cosmos beyond Earth. Modern scientists would later use the concept as [[wp:luminiferous aether|luminiferous aether]] to explain how light could move through what appeared to be empty vacuum. It was refuted by experiment in the late 19th century.
